payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including BLEU scores, model output variance, and manual inspections.

claims.text: The quality of the data is evaluated using corpus-level BLEU scores and a normalized quality score called BLEU_MS, which accounts for model output variance across different speakers.
Manual inspections are conducted on translations with high perplexity and low character ratios, ensuring quality control before finalizing the data.
Validated transcripts are used for building the dataset, ensuring that only high-quality data is included in CoVoST.
